note: Muhlenberg County (KY) parcel polygons are only published through the PVA's qPublic/Beacon Schneider viewer, which is a web app behind a bot challenge (HTTP 403) with no public ArcGIS REST or file download found. Kentucky's state server (kygisserver.ky.gov WGS84WM_Services folder) lists PVA parcel services only for Webster County; the KYTC PVA availability layer marks MUHLENBERG as 'With Ownership' but no Muhlenberg parcel service is published. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online for Muhlenberg parcels returned only roads, utilities, tourism and similar layers. Commercial vendors (Regrid, Dynamo, Acres) were not used since they are paid and not county-run.
